title: Korean Patchwork Coloring Book
subtitle: Bold and Easy Designs for Adults: 30 Calming Jogakbo, Dancheong & Flower Lattice Patterns from Traditional Korea
back_lines: 30 bold & easy designs, printed on one side
Jogakbo patchwork, palace flowers, temple door lattices
A short story under every design
A color test page to try your markers
description:
Bold lines, big spaces, and the quiet beauty of traditional Korean design.

This coloring book brings together 30 patterns inspired by Korea: jogakbo patchwork wrapping cloths, dancheong flower rings painted on palaces and temples, and kkotsal flower-lattice temple doors. Each design has a one-line story so you learn a little about Korean culture as you color.

  • 30 bold and easy designs for relaxing, not stressing
  • Every design printed on its own page, back left blank so markers will not bleed through
  • A color test page at the front
  • Large 8.5 x 11 inch pages

A calm gift for coloring lovers, K-drama fans and anyone dreaming of a trip to Korea.
